title: Madoka Magica: Walpurgisnacht Rising Passes 1 Billion Yen in 4 Days, New CM Released
content: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie: Walpurgisnacht Rising has surpassed 1 billion yen at the Japanese box office within its first four days. A new CM trailer featuring previously unseen footage from the film was also released. The movie opened in Japan on August 28 and passed the 1 billion yen mark by August 31.
author: Anime Corner

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 15 Preview
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 15 (Episode 81 overall) preview ahead of its September 2, 2026 premiere. This will be the fourth episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc .
author: Anime Corner

title: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie Reveals New 25th Anniversary Visual, 4K Remaster Screening
content: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie ( Knockin’ on Heaven’s Door ) has revealed a new visual commemorating the 25th anniversary of its theatrical release. A 4K remastered version of the film will also return to theaters in Japan on October 30, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Baki Isekai Spinoff Manga Gets TV Anime
content: TMS Anime announced on Monday that Baki Gaiden: Retsu Kaioh wa Isekai Tensei Shitemo Ikkō ni Kamawan ( Baki Side Story - Kaioh Retsu Doesn't Mind At All If He Gets Reincarnated in Another World), a spinoff manga of Keisuke Itagaki 's Baki manga, is receiving a TV anime.adaptation.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action It's Strictly Business Series Announces Cast. Staff, November 5 Debut
content: The official website for the live-action series of Mitsubachi Miyuki 's It’s Strictly Business (Eigyо̄ Desu kara) boys-love manga revealed on Tuesday the series' teaser visual, main cast and staff, and November 5 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Sirotan TV Anime to Premiere on October 3
content: The official website for the Sirotan television anime based on Creative Yoko 's seal mascot revealed on Tuesday the anime's main visual and October 3 premiere. The anime will premiere in TV Asahi 's new short anime programming block " PicoAni " on October 3 at 4:29 p.m. JST (3:29 a.m. EDT).
author: ANN

title: Focus: Kyoto Animation Charts New Frontier with Sparks of Tomorrow
content: Anime fans gathered on Day 2 of Anime Expo to watch the U.S. premiere of the newest masterfully animated work from beloved studio Kyoto Animation, Sparks of Tomorrow ( Nijusseiki Denki Mokuroku ), and hear from the staff behind the Summer 2026 TV anime.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Manga 'Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu' Ends in Two Chapters
content: The official X account for Mokumokuren 's Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu ( The Summer Hikaru Died ) manga announced on Tuesday that the series will end in two chapters. The 50th chapter is scheduled to be released on October 13, with the 51st and final chapter to follow on October 20.
author: MyAnimeList
